                           ORDER NO. 4
FINDING APPLICATION ADMINISTRATIVELY COMPLETE, PROPOSED NOTICE
         SUFFICIENT, AND ENTERING PROCEDURAL SCHEDULE

       On April 7, 2026, El Paso Electric Company (EPE) filed an application seeking approval
of a new tariff applicable to very large, high load factor customers.

       On May 1, 2026, Commission Staff filed its recommendation on administrative
completeness, notice, and proposed a procedural schedule for further processing of the application.

       The administrative law judge finds EPE’s application administratively complete and
sufficient for further review and proposed notice sufficient. The following procedural schedule
applies for further processing:

                     Event                                               Date
 Deadline for EPE to file proof of notice                           May 22, 2026
 Deadline for intervention                                          May 22, 2026
 Deadline for intervenors to file comments on                       June 1, 2026
 the merits or to request a hearing
 Deadline for Commission Staff to file a                            June 8, 2026
 recommendation on final disposition or to
 request a hearing
 Deadline for EPE to request a hearing or                           June 16, 2026
 respond to intervenor comments and
 Commission Staff’s recommendation on final
 disposition; or if no disputed issues exist,
 deadline for parties to file a joint motion to
 admit and proposed findings of fact,
 conclusions of law, and ordering paragraphs
 Docket No. 59611                                            Order No. 4                    Page 2 of 2


          Signed at Austin, Texas on the 5th day of May 2026.
                                                               PUBLIC UTILITY COMMISSION OF TEXAS




                                                               ERIC YOON
                                                               ADMINISTRATIVE LAW JUDGE
